const cfgItems = $node['Config'].json?.assignments?.assignments ?? [];
const cfg = Object.fromEntries(cfgItems.map((item) => [item.name, item.value]));
const reportDateExpr = cfg.reportDate || "CURRENT_DATE";
const workflowName = cfg.workflowName || 'LT - Report Attribution Bridge';
const sourceSystem = cfg.sourceSystem || 'bridge';
const identitySql = `WITH contacts AS (
  SELECT
    source_key AS ghl_contact_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(payload_json->>'email', payload_json->>'Email', dimensions_json->>'contact.email', ''))), ''), NULL) AS email,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(payload_json->>'phone', payload_json->>'Phone', dimensions_json->>'contact.phone', ''), '[^0-9+]', '', 'g'), ''), NULL) AS phone,
    loaded_at AS seen_at,
    payload_json
  FROM report_raw_ghl_contacts
  WHERE report_date = ${reportDateExpr}
)
INSERT INTO report_bridge_identity_map (
  identity_type, identity_value, normalized_value, ghl_contact_id, ghl_opportunity_id, match_confidence, match_rule, first_seen_at, last_seen_at, payload_json, updated_at
)
SELECT 'contact_id', ghl_contact_id, ghl_contact_id, ghl_contact_id, NULL, 100, 'contact_id_exact', MIN(seen_at), MAX(seen_at), jsonb_build_object('source', 'report_raw_ghl_contacts'), NOW()
FROM contacts
WHERE ghl_contact_id IS NOT NULL AND ghl_contact_id <> ''
GROUP BY ghl_contact_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 'email', email, email, ghl_contact_id, NULL, 95, 'email_exact', MIN(seen_at), MAX(seen_at), jsonb_build_object('source', 'report_raw_ghl_contacts'), NOW()
FROM contacts
WHERE email IS NOT NULL AND email <> ''
GROUP BY email, ghl_contact_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 'phone', phone, phone, ghl_contact_id, NULL, 85, 'phone_exact', MIN(seen_at), MAX(seen_at), jsonb_build_object('source', 'report_raw_ghl_contacts'), NOW()
FROM contacts
WHERE phone IS NOT NULL AND phone <> ''
GROUP BY phone, ghl_contact_id
ON CONFLICT (identity_type, identity_value) DO UPDATE SET
  normalized_value = EXCLUDED.normalized_value,
  ghl_contact_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.ghl_contact_id, report_bridge_identity_map.ghl_contact_id),
  match_confidence = GREATEST(report_bridge_identity_map.match_confidence, EXCLUDED.match_confidence),
  match_rule = EXCLUDED.match_rule,
  last_seen_at = GREATEST(report_bridge_identity_map.last_seen_at, EXCLUDED.last_seen_at),
  payload_json = EXCLUDED.payload_json,
  updated_at = NOW();`;
const trafficSql = `DELETE FROM report_bridge_traffic_to_lead
WHERE report_date = ${reportDateExpr};

WITH contacts AS (
  SELECT
    source_key AS ghl_contact_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_source_first', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_source_last', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Source First', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Source Last', ''), 'unknown') AS traffic_source,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_medium_first', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_medium_last', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Medium First', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Medium Last', ''), 'unknown') AS medium,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_campaign_first', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_campaign_last', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Campaign First', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Campaign Last', ''), 'unknown') AS campaign,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_landing_page_first', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_landing_page_last', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Landing Page First', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Landing Page Last', ''), 'unknown') AS landing_page,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.lt_last_routing_channel', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.warm_source', ''), 'unattributed') AS channel,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.lt_last_routing_reason', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.warm_trigger_type', ''), 'ghl_utm_attribution') AS reason,
    payload_json
  FROM report_raw_ghl_contacts
  WHERE report_date = ${reportDateExpr}
)
INSERT INTO report_bridge_traffic_to_lead (
  report_date, ga_session_id, traffic_source, medium, campaign, landing_page, ghl_contact_id, match_confidence, match_rule, match_reason, source_trace, created_at, updated_at
)
SELECT
  ${reportDateExpr},
  ghl_contact_id,
  traffic_source,
  medium,
  campaign,
  landing_page,
  ghl_contact_id,
  CASE WHEN traffic_source <> 'unknown' THEN 70 ELSE 50 END,
  'ghl_utm_attribution',
  reason,
  jsonb_build_object('channel', channel, 'payload', payload_json),
  NOW(),
  NOW()
FROM contacts;`;
const saleSql = `DELETE FROM report_bridge_lead_to_sale
WHERE report_date = ${reportDateExpr};

WITH opps AS (
  SELECT
    source_key AS ghl_opportunity_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact_id', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.id', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->>'contactId', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->>'contact_id', '')) AS ghl_contact_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'pipeline_name', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->>'pipelineName', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->'pipeline'->>'name', ''), 'unknown') AS pipeline,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'pipeline_stage_name', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->>'pipelineStageName', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->'pipelineStage'->>'name', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->>'stage', ''), 'unknown') AS stage,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'status', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->>'status', ''), 'open') AS status,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(metrics_json->>'monetary_value', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->>'monetaryValue', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->>'amount', ''), '0')::numeric AS monetary_value,
    payload_json
  FROM report_raw_ghl_opportunities
  WHERE report_date = ${reportDateExpr}
)
INSERT INTO report_bridge_lead_to_sale (
  report_date, ghl_contact_id, ghl_opportunity_id, pipeline, stage, match_confidence, match_rule, match_reason, source_trace, created_at, updated_at
)
SELECT
  ${reportDateExpr},
  COALESCE(ghl_contact_id, ''),
  ghl_opportunity_id,
  pipeline,
  stage,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(ghl_contact_id, '') <> '' THEN 95 ELSE 60 END,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(ghl_contact_id, '') <> '' THEN 'opportunity_contact_link' ELSE 'opportunity_only' END,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(ghl_contact_id, '') <> '' THEN 'Linked by raw opportunity contact id' ELSE 'Contact id missing on raw opportunity' END,
  jsonb_build_object('status', status, 'monetary_value', monetary_value, 'payload', payload_json),
  NOW(),
  NOW()
FROM opps;`;
return [{json:{sql:identitySql}},{json:{sql:trafficSql}},{json:{sql:saleSql}}];

const s = $node['Summarize Run'].json;
return [{json:{ok:true,workflow:s.workflowName,status:'prepared',source:s.sourceSystem,reportDate:s.reportDate,executedQueries:s.executedQueries,note:'GHL-only bridge scaffold is live and ready for GA4-enabled attribution later.'}}];
